items.title: docs(atlas): classification revalidation cadence — rule-triggered rescans, sampled audits, allowlist expiry (#6051)
items.body: ## What Design record for #6051: `doc/2026-11-09T05-10-38Z_design_atlas_revalidation_cadence.md` — the Atlas classification revalidation cadence under parent #6021. Decides, per the #6051 acceptance criteria (trigger table, scope per trigger, audit method with miss-rate estimate, allowlist lifecycle): - **Triggers (T1–T6)** — recognizer/rule-pack change, new source class or tier-rule change, corpus-growth threshold (≥5% / ≥1,000-chunk run, estimates), quarterly calendar round, allowlist-expiry sweep, incident/ad-hoc signal; priority-ordered with subsumption. - **Scope per trigger per layer** — deterministic + Tier A + pattern pack run full on T1/T4; Tier B NER runs full-internal only when Tier B inputs changed or at most annually, sampled (1,000-chunk pilot shape + 160-chunk secret sample) otherwise; vector-neighborhood and staging checks scoped per trigger. Inherits #6048 run mechanics (run_id, config_hash, 500-chunk batches, idempotent resume). - **Sampled human audit** — every round samples the negatives (300 internal + 160 secret sharing the #6048 calibration draw, estimates) plus a 10% dismissal re-review; rule-of-three/Wilson miss-rate bound tracked round over round, with escalation (catastrophic miss → incomplete round; >2% miss rate → full census; >10% overturn → queue re-opened). - **Allowlist lifecycle** — mandatory reason + expires_at (max 180d) + owner + scoped predicate; T1 suspends affected entries; T5 re-examines un-suppressed before renewal; grandfathering reported per round; no bare recognizer-wide suppressions. - **#6019 plug-in** — staging merge gate, new-class onboarding T2, periodic T4 gate blocking bulk backfills while incomplete, off-peak plan-spend scheduling. - **Dependency honesty** — #6021 has no recurrence recommendation yet; this record assumes the standing-gate branch (parent-program direction) and §8 states the one-off fallback exactly. Forks nothing from #6021; touches #6019 only at the seams; #6049/#6050 untouched siblings. Source note: the prior-art path named in the #6051 body is absent on the fleet laptop; the record is written from the body finding summary + #6021 figures + landed #6048 design and says so, per the task packet. ## Tests Docs-only. `git diff --check` clean. No code tests apply (per packet). Closes #6051 Queue task 13868 (lane opencode, direct). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: docs(fleet): #8579 wipe-test audit of the queue database schema
items.body: ## What Slice 1 of the fleet unification (#8575): a wipe-test audit of the fleet-queue Turso schema — `doc/2026-11-11_design_id8579_queue_schema_wipe_test_audit.md`. Audit and plan only; no schema changes. ## Contents - All 9 tables (`tasks`, `leases`, `lanes`, `workers`, `checkpoints`, `repo_task_lane_ledger`, `events`, `creation_outbox`, `creation_outbox_circuit`) classified field by field as coordination / durable truth / GitHub mirror cache, with the evidence taken from the schema of record in `pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet-queue/src/turso_queue.rs` (SCHEMA constant + additive ALTERs) and the crate's writers/readers. - Headline findings: `tasks.result` + terminal `status` are durable truth whose home is the outcome agent note + issue close; `repo_task_lane_ledger` is the durable assignment record; `events` splits (durable transitions vs coordinative noise); `lanes.enabled` is an operator decision that belongs in repo config; both `dedupe_key`s are derivations, not stores. - For every durable-truth item: the named GitHub home or the derivation that rebuilds it. - A migration order for slices 2–7 (#8580–#8585) naming which slice owns each move, with exit checks (slice 3 = the truth moves; slice 7 = archive + the closing wipe-test drill, using this audit as the diff checklist). - Also records what is NOT in the DB yet: slice 2's mirror tables and slice 4's merge-order tables don't exist and must be born with the right class. ## Verification - Schema read directly from the canonical broker source on current main; additive migration columns cross-checked against `TASK_COLS` / `LEDGER_COLS`. - Prettier-formatted; `git diff --check` clean; docs-only change (+1 file). References #8579, #8575. --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
